Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full equipment-monitor payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Machine health","asset":{"name":"Trailblazer Assembly Cell","model":"TB-9000","assetId":"LINE-3","location":"Plant 2 · Bay 4","imageUrl":"/resource/asaMfgTrailblazerCell"},"status":"running","statusLabel":"Running","updatedText":"Live · updated 12s ago","metrics":[{"label":"OEE","value":"87","unit":"%","state":"good"},{"label":"Spindle temp","value":"62","unit":"°C","state":"warn"},{"label":"Throughput","value":"142","unit":"/hr","state":"good"},{"label":"Uptime","value":"6d 4h","state":"good"}],"trend":{"label":"OEE · last 12h","points":[72,78,74,80,83,81,85,84,86,88,87,87]},"submitText":"Create work order","submitValue":"Open a work order for the Trailblazer Assembly Cell (LINE-3)"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Machine health'. - 'asset' (object, REQUIRED): the machine. 'name' (string, REQUIRED); optional 'model','assetId','location' (strings, joined into a meta line); 'imageUrl' (string, same-origin https URL or '/resource/<Name>'; use '/resource/asaMfgTrailblazerCell' for the sample machine). - 'status' (string, optional): one of 'running','idle','fault','maintenance','offline'. Defaults to 'running'; drives the status pill color. - 'statusLabel' (string, optional): overrides the displayed status text. - 'updatedText' (string, optional): a freshness line, e.g. 'Live · updated 12s ago'. - 'metrics' (array, REQUIRED, 1 to 4 objects): the metric tiles. Each has 'label' (string) and 'value' (string or number); optional 'unit' (string, e.g. '%','°C','/hr') and 'state' (one of 'good','warn','bad' — colors the tile; defaults to 'good'). More than four are ignored. - 'trend' (object, optional): a sparkline. 'points' (array of 2+ numbers, REQUIRED for the sparkline to draw); optional 'label' (string). - 'submitText' (string, optional): action-button label, e.g. 'Create work order'. Omit to hide it. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the exact message sent back when tapped; defaults to 'submitText'. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
